title: Applying autoresearch to backdoor discovery
description: Autoresearch hands the experiment loop to an AI agent: edit one file, run a fixed test, read one number, keep or revert. What it is, what carries over to new problems, and where it breaks, with a backdoor hunt on Jane Street's Dormant LLM puzzle as the case study.

title: Can Test-Mode Caution Transfer to Ordinary Prompts?
description: A test-style prompt initially appeared to improve privacy protection across five open models. A controlled follow-up found the privacy reminder mattered more than test framing; neuron steering then beat random controls in four of five model families, with mixed results across folds and judges.

title: Why two open chat models refuse less in Hindi
description: Asked the same harmful requests in English and in Hindi, two open chat models (Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct) refuse far less often in Hindi. What they do instead, what changes inside them, and how far steering can bring the refusals back.
